targets.title: What makes entrepreneurs happy? Determinants of satisfaction among founders.
targets.evidence_quote: This paper contributes to entrepreneurs’ satisfaction research (Stephan, 2018) by means of what can be regarded as a conceptual replication and extension of CV (albeit only partially so).
targets.outcome_quote: Regarding performance, CV find strong effects (both positive and negative). We replicate the positive effect of performance on satisfaction with income, but we find positive effects instead of CV’s negative effects on satisfaction with work and work-life balance.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Authors explicitly confirm the income association and contrast opposite associations for work and work-life balance. Further discussion describes both confirmations and discrepancies, with no overriding overall verdict.

reasoning: Publisher PDF identity verified against title, all eight authors and printed DOI. New Belgian sample conceptually replicates Carree and Verheul; related theory, measures and background studies are not additional targets.
